authorizations: User approved starting the24h experiment. Keep16GiB workspace and GPU reproduction.

quality.split: native local ASGP pool; strict input disjointness; finite domain exceptions recorded
quality.selection: native training-selected final champion, no test-guided selection; histories descriptive only

pilot.selection_uses: wall time/resource validation only; no heldout evaluation before selection
pilot.reuse: all qualifying pilot runs retained if exact selected settings; never choose the fastest repetition

audits.per_search: existing first16 final programs independently re-evaluated on CPU; not a full-population proof
audits.quality: every recorded champion and final candidate audited against specified train/test through its native CPU representation; dedup only post-search

interpretation.speed: one-shot coarse system search speedup, not pure hardware acceleration
interpretation.quality: five-run exploratory comparison, no equivalence/noninferiority claim
interpretation.asgp_baseline: fixed benchmark search_asgp_1t: sequential original Score/operators, elite1, whole-population rescoring without cross-generation program fitness cache; not the stock ASGP Run entry
